ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a forward deployed engineering team integrating AI software into customer hardware design workflows. You will work directly with engineering teams to solve practical problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and physics.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Deploy software into customer engineering environments and integrate it with existing tools and workflows.

 - Debug challenges at the hardware-software boundary, including physics simulation and EDA integrations.

 - Collaborate with customer teams to understand design challenges and adapt software to their needs.

 - Ship features and fixes that help unblock hardware projects.

 - Travel to customer sites and work with distributed teams.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Five or more years of experience building or delivering production software systems.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience in at least one hardware discipline, such as electrical, RF, mechanical, thermal, chemical, or firmware engineering.

 - A cross-disciplinary education or substantial hands-on hardware projects.

 - Experience with difficult, ambiguous production problems and integrating software into hardware workflows.

 - Familiarity with physics simulation, CAD, or EDA tools such as Ansys HFSS, KiCad, LTspice, or similar.

 - Forward deployment, systems integration, or customer-facing engineering experience is a plus. PhDs are welcome.

 - San Francisco-based candidates need chip design, semiconductor, or EDA experience. Los Angeles-based candidates need US citizenship and must be eligible for ITAR clearance.

 - For candidates based outside New York, availability for regular travel to New York is required.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $150,000 to $275,000 annually. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, five days per week. Candidates in San Francisco or Los Angeles may be considered, with regular travel to New York.
